justifications.r1: Naya ramp with 2-CMC dorks and Food token artifact utility.
justifications.r2: Impulse exile draw on every end step generates continuous card advantage.
justifications.a1: High density of exile-matters payoffs and counter multipliers.
justifications.a2: Engine starts churning Food and counters on Turns 4–5.
justifications.p1: Presents tall/wide modified creature army on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 2 opponent untap steps to execute combat wins.
justifications.p3: Exiled cards are revealed to the entire table, giving opponents advance warning.
justifications.i1: Naya instant-speed removal suite (Beast Within, Swords to Plowshares, Chaos Warp).
justifications.i2: Light group-hug style impulse triggers; no hard denial.
justifications.s2: Food tokens remain on board after wipes to regain life, but creatures must be rebuilt.
justifications.s3: Deck heavily synergizes with Rocco's exile trigger.
